<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 268.1939, which corresponds to the protonated molecule [M + H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of approximately 267.1867 Da. The formula that best matches this exact mass and is consistent with the observed ¹³C isotopic pattern is C₁₅H₂₃O₄. Therefore, the molecular formula of the compound in the sample is C15H23O4.</thought>
<final_answer>C15H23O4</final_answer>
